visibleTestCases.title: Ping-Pong Single Roundtrip
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P = ping_actor:start_responder(), Res = ping_actor:ping(P, <<"syn">>), P ! stop, Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Sends a ping request with binary payload and receives matching pong reply.

visibleTestCases.title: Asynchronous Broadcast
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin P1 = ping_actor:start_responder(), P2 = ping_actor:start_responder(), Res = ping_actor:broadcast([P1, P2], stop), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Broadcasts stop message asynchronously to two processes, returning {sent, 2}.
